01: I've been making dua for weeks... and nothing happens!
03: Then let me tell you about Zakariya, peace be upon him. He waited for his answer for many, many years.
04: He had grown very old. His bones were weak, his hair had turned white, and his wife could not have children.
05: Still, he called his Lord quietly: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.
06: After all those years... did Allah answer him?
07: Allah gave Zakariya, peace be upon him, good news of a son named Yahya, a name given to no one before him.
08: And Yahya, peace be upon him, grew up wise even as a boy, gentle, and kind to his parents.
09: He said: never have I been disappointed in calling You, my Lord. So, keep asking.
10: Then I won't stop. I'll keep asking.
